For interviews, press enquiries or creative collaboration, get in touch. The biography and portrait below are available as reference materials; please confirm image-use permissions before publication.

Artan Davoodi is a musician, songwriter and producer whose main instrument is the piano. His work moves between instrumental music, acoustic songs and photography. Memory and personal experience shape his songwriting, while his visual work offers another way of observing and telling stories.
